DOL Women's Bureau National Database of Childcare Prices, county x provider type x age, 2008-2022. Evaluated as the state price source. Every price is a FULL-TIME WEEKLY price; there is no part-time series, and "full-time" is each state's own definition (ME 21-30 hrs, IN 35, MI 45, NJ 51.7, several states provider-defined). Fetchable from Bouchet; www.dol.gov returns 403 from Windows.

NDCP technical report (ICF, September 2024). Gives the price-mode conversion formulas (hourly x40, half-day x10, daily x5, monthly x12/52, yearly /52) and the per-state notes on what full-time means. Held in raw/documentation/.

NHES-ECPP 2019 public-use (NCES). CAREHOURX is continuous, so NHES can be cut at 5 and 10 hrs/week and reproduce the NSECE universe ratio -- the only NSECE constant a second survey can measure. It disagrees: NSECE 1.098, NHES 1.194. Finest geography is CENREG, four Census regions; no state. Derived on the cluster from ecpp_pu_pert.csv (19 MB), summary held in raw/.
